watch.summary: A streamer rolls his egg into a hidden game trap, instantly causing him to rage quit to the main menu in frustration.

beats.what: Creator comfortably guides his egg along a wooden obstacle track.
The egg rolls directly onto a mechanical launcher platform.
The trap triggers, launching and ruining the egg instantly.
Creator yells in anger and swiftly exits the game to a black screen.
Creator sits back in his chair complaining about how close he was.

watch.author: game_itself
watch.key_line: You've got to be freaking kidding me... get me out of here.
watch.why: The sudden turn from careful navigation to complete failure creates instant shock value. The speed of his rage quit adds a relatable comedic punctuation mark to the failure.
